sentences.span: After its results the night before, Meta (-6.98%) fell and its CDS widened +7.2bps to 118bps
sentences.why: DB Reid confirms the exact -6.98% move and CDS widening; GS Johnstone note (21546) confirms the revenue beat with advertising growth of 26% and 'healthy AI-led advertising... demand', supporting the advertising-demand framing.

sentences.span: the issue is simply a repricing of the cost of capital... You either cut capex, delay deployment or increasingly fund through equity. None are particularly supportive of equity prices.
sentences.why: Direct match to Rich Privorotsky's (Goldman) note: repricing of cost of capital, three choices, none support equity prices.

sentences.span: Definitely felt like a lot of positions were flushed, with price action moving well beyond individual fundamentals
sentences.why: Generic bridging sentence (no figures/attribution) supported by the de-grossing/stop-out narrative running through multiple sources (GS Singhal Prime HFs Update, 'Historic Degrossing' piece, Privorotsky's 'positions were flushed').

sentences.span: reposition selectively back into the AI complex starting with Power, Hyperscalers, Inference and Cyber. For limited loss implementations, GSTMTAIP Nov 105 120% call spread costs 2.75%... we would be using GSXUCYCL Index as a funding short
sentences.why: Goldman's US Equities Weekly Rundown matches the basket names, the 2.75% Nov call spread, and funding via shorting the cyclicals index exactly.

sentences.span: we maintain our view "use any bounce to de-risk"
sentences.why: Barclays' Asia fund-positioning team's exact phrase; BTIG's 'Midterms Unlikely a Clearing Event' note (21964) separately confirms SPX 200-DMA test toward 7300 instead of a post-midterm rally.

sentences.span: now expect spreads to moderately overshoot those ranges... she sees the risks firmly tilted towards more widening
sentences.why: Direct quote/paraphrase of Goldman's Amanda Lynam on spreads overshooting the downside case with risk tilted to widening.

sentences.span: the fundamental picture appears more resilient than recent price action would suggest... Contagion remains contained, with hyperscalers, broader Tech & Growth style largely insulated
sentences.why: Barclays' neo-cloud/equities note matches both the 'fundamentals better' and 'spillover to hyperscalers contained' claims verbatim in substance.

sentences.span: the lowest level of gas inventories in 14 years... a year-end TTF forecast of 70 EUR/MWh vs 87 EUR/MWh trading now
sentences.why: Goldman commodity strategists' note matches NW Europe's 14-year-low inventories and the 87-to-70 EUR/MWh Dutch (TTF) gas forecast exactly.

sentences.span: 10y OAT/Bund spreads are now at their widest since the introduction of the Euro... Goldman's Bloomberg chart now has it at 173bps, with French 10Y yields at 5.08%
sentences.why: Exact match for yield, spread, and 'widest since the euro' framing, sourced to Goldman.

sentences.span: We expect the Committee to keep the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.75-4.00%... We are likely to see Hammack, Kashkari and Logan repeat their July dissents in favor of a hike
sentences.why: Rabobank's FOMC Preview matches the rate hold, non-unanimous framing, and all three named dissenters exactly.

sentences.span: "There has been zero clamouring," said one of the people. "All the prior times [OpenAI] have been on there's been a frenzy. This time is a bit of a thud."
sentences.why: Direct quote match for zero clamouring vs. prior frenzy.

sentences.span: talking about a valuation of around $1.5 trillion, some $500 billion below the $2 trillion previously penciled in for its November IPO... the two biggest frontier labs have shaved some $650 billion off what they hoped to be worth in the span of seven days
sentences.why: Exact match on all three figures and the one-week framing.

sentences.span: OpenAI, which is on the hook for some $1.5 trillion in compute commitments
"The market needs to see a successful IPO," said Chang. "These companies need funding."
sentences.why: Jimmy Chang, CIO at Rockefeller Global Family Office, quoted verbatim; 'listing' is a faithful paraphrase of 'IPO'.

sentences.span: JPM's Matt Reiner said demand was "very low in hyperscalers and Neoclouds across the board," with the only real pocket of buying in security software
sentences.why: Direct match for attribution and content.
